verdict.rationale: Box ships Box Sign, its own e-signature product. The Box Sign API lets you send documents for signature from your own app and track them through to a signed file, and it brings the full Box Sign web app experience into your application, so signing happens where the files already live. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Box Sign, and deeper documentation detail (signer workflows, templates, audit trail, where signed copies are stored).
